mapper.select: SELECT id, course_code, course_name, semester, description, location, schedule_info, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM courses WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, course_code, course_name, semester, description, location, schedule_info, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM courses WHERE course_code = #{courseCode} AND semester = #{semester} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses ( course_code, course_name, semester, description, location, schedule_info, status, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{semester}, #{description}, #{location}, #{scheduleInfo}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE courses SET course_code = #{courseCode}, course_name = #{courseName}, semester = #{semester}, description = #{description}, location = #{location}, schedule_info = #{scheduleInfo}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, course_code, course_name, semester, description, location, schedule_info, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM courses WHERE created_by = #{createdBy} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT c.id, c.course_code, c.course_name, c.semester, c.description, c.location, c.schedule_info, c.status, c.created_by, c.updated_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.is_deleted FROM courses c JOIN course_members cm ON cm.course_id = c.id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT id, course_code, course_name, semester, description, location, schedule_info, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM courses WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
